### Li Hua's Impression of the "Blood and Wine" Expansion

Li Hua expresses a strong favorable opinion of the "Blood and Wine" expansion in "The Rings of Power." She is captivated by the depth of lore and its storytelling, praising the way each mission contributes to the rising tension and intensity of the plot. Li Hua perceives this particular storyline as epic and key in shaping the game's narrative dynamics. She is eager to see how the unfolding of the board game's story, with its strategic missions and character interactions, will lead to potentially impactful outcomes, something she senses could be epic considering the series' building of stakes and anticipation.
